channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Mikel Brown | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Mikel Brown from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Mikel Brown
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Jordi Fernandez on whether the #Nets expect rookie Mikel Brown Jr. to be available at all this preseason:

“I believe so. That's the plan. But we've got to see what the next step is.”

Jordi Fernandez on Mikel Brown, Oct 5, 2026. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Mikel Brown
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Jordi Fernandez on Mikel Brown Jr. working back from ankle injury:

“He's been doing non-contact. He’s in good spirits. He's engaged with the practices. He's learning what's going on, getting the reps that he can. And so far, that's where we are right now.”

Jordi Fernandez on Mikel Brown, Sep 30, 2026. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Julius Randle on Mikel Brown
item.description:
“Third hole in, they were trying to take their shirts off. You know, it's just like they didn't understand golf etiquette. Mikel (Brown) broke a club, a driver on one of the holes. So I learned really fast that I'm dealing with kids.”

Julius Randle on Mikel Brown, Sep 29, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Vince Carter on Donovan Mitchell, Mikel Brown
item.description:
Vince Carter:

“Donovan Mitchell just got the bag… but he had high praises about you being the best freshman ever at Louisville. Like, what did that do for your confidence? Mikel Brown Jr.:”

Vince Carter on Donovan Mitchell, Mikel Brown, Jul 29, 2026. Source: Youtube.
